title: The past-ruling guard passes a question whose pick is the ruling's own way out
why: The past-ruling guard (Stop hook) read item 684 as reopening R26 (batch-freeze-lane-set-enforce) and decision no-merge-onto-red-main, but the recommended option is the way out that decision names (--base-red-ok for the batch that carries the fix, Cockpit 178 a); the owner's word was needed only because the harness classifier blocked the runner.
note: A note until it repeats (rule building-guard-needs-incident). Fix candidate: the judge reads whether the recommended option is a path the cited ruling itself allows, and passes it.
